plain: Training a strong model on labels from a weaker one, to see whether the strong model ends up better than its teacher.
eli5: A little kid coaching a big kid, and checking whether the big kid still ends up playing better than the coach.
technical: Burns et al. (2023): fine-tune a strong model on a weak supervisor's labels and measure the performance gap recovered (PGR) between the weak supervisor and the strong ceiling, an analogy for humans supervising superhuman models.
